reasoning:
The opening paragraph at [248,580) reads:

This GCC Runtime Library Exception ("Exception") is an additional
permission under section 7 of the GNU General Public License, version
3 ("GPLv3"). It applies to a given file (the "Runtime Library") that
bears a notice placed by the copyright holder of the file stating that
the file is governed by GPLv3 along with this Exception.

GPLv3 section 7 defines additional permissions as exceptions to one or more GPL conditions, distinguishes whole-program permissions from permissions covering only part of a program, and allows a relevant source file to state the added terms or indicate where to find them. Section 1 of the exception separately conditions the Target Code grant on a combination with Independent Modules and generation of all Target Code by Eligible Compilation Processes. Conveyance terms must be consistent with the Independent Modules’ licensing.
